g.aria-label: Step 1 · Infinitesimal Flow Map Jacobian Over Step h
Φ_{t→t+h}(x) = x + h f(x, t) + o(h) ⇒ DΦ = I + h J(x, t) + o(h)
Step 2 · Near-Identity Determinant Expansion (Off-Diagonals Are O(h²))
det(I + hJ) = ∏_{i=1}^d (1 + h J_{ii}) + O(h²) = 1 + h tr(J) + O(h²)
Step 3 · Take Limit h → 0 in Change-of-Variables Formula (Liouville Equation)
d/dt log p_t(x(t)) = −tr(∂f / ∂x(x(t), t)) = −∇ · f(x(t), t)
